Dedicated servers should be a new breath of life into this game. I haven’t played for a while because of how awful disconnects are, hopefully I can get back into it with dedicated servers

items.title: (Locals) Deck that can play through a negate or two?
items.text:
(Locals) Deck that can play through a negate or two?
Hey guys, pretty simple and straightforward I’m looking for a fun deck that doesn’t completely get shut down by a droll or effect veiler. With the new ban list coming I want something fresh and fun.

I’m used to playing decks that are fun and explosive when uninterrupted (blue eyes for ex) but I’m tired of having to pass turn after one interruption. What’s some semi competitive decks (for locals) that has more than one play they can make? Not really interested in salads/sky striker/thunder dragons as I like to play less popular decks, sorry if that’s too limiting for my request.

Once upon a time I played around with true Draco, to be honest with you I don’t think I ever got a solid grasp on what cards you should be searching, when to summon etc and so I sold my Draco cards. I’ve been keeping my eyes on cyber dragons it looks like a fun deck, wasn’t sure how it performed through negates though. Thanks for your comment
Will check out trickstar thanks man

I saw dark warrior orcusts after Dinh-Kha took 3rd with it. Looks like fun with a lot of tools in case you get negated but I’m just unsure if it’s commonly played at locals near me. I don’t want a deck that I’m gonna have a lot of mirror matches like how it is with salads and thunder dragons. Also as someone else said now that summon sorceress is out I wonder if it’d be better to just drop the warriors and run danger orcusts instead
Bet, I’ll check it out again later today thanks for the recommendation mate

items.title: Any NYC players here near Manhattan?
items.text:
Any NYC players here near Manhattan?
Hey guys, I’m looking for locals preferably in the manhattan area but really anywhere within a reasonable distance from the city. I’ve seen a couple shops but they only had a couple nights for yugioh and I’m looking for somewhere I can go a bit more often just to hang and play with you guys. Anyone have recommendations? 

(And yes I’ve looked at the store finder but I wanted to see if anyone here goes to particular stores)
Bet I’ll go check these spots out, thanks man 👍

I actually saw Montasy comics but I didn’t get to stop by, have you ever been and if so what did you think of it? Brooklyn is a bit out of the way for me but if it’s a good atmosphere I’d be willing to make the trip

Yeah I definitely hear that about the work schedule, I wouldn’t be able to make it 5pm on a Monday most times. Is yugioh play restricted to certain time frames or can you go in and play with others any time?
Sounds good, I’m gonna try to stop by there maybe this week or next, hopefully I’ll catch you guys there. It’s OTS right?

That sounds really dope, I moved not too long ago from Florida so my cards are still over there. I’m gonna have them shipped but I wanted to find a solid place to play so hopefully montasy is nice otherwise I’ll try to figure out how to take the subway to Kings games haha
There are teams who work on gameplay, there are teams who work on cosmetics. One has nothing to do with the other.
